source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Corporation Division

access.summary: Official free open-data API/export; dataset-specific license is null and reuse rests on the Oregon Open Data Program.

fields: Registry number, business name, type, registry date, jurisdiction and principal address are selectable; person, agent, representative and mailing rows remain excluded.
status_semantics: Active registration and assumed-name renewal are registry evidence, not verified operation, licensure, solvency, public access or legal-entity ownership.
address_zip: Principal-place address and ZIP are reported facts rather than verified premises; assumed names remain brands and ZIP5/ZIP+4 stay separate.
temporal: Retained metadata reports 2026-09-01; differing portal/catalog observations do not prove a newer record release and require a governed preflight.

Official free use, modification and sharing authorization.

strongest_next_action: Independently verify and reuse the retained release; establish actual metadata freshness before scheduling an app-owned refresh.
